# SAM Intelligence Group

> Engineering data platforms, MLOps systems, custom web and .NET software, and applied AI workflows.

## Core Engineering Services
1. **Data Engineering & ETL**
   - Reliable ingestion, validation, ETL/ELT transformation workflows, storage architecture, and reporting-ready analytical foundations.
   - Stack: Python, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, SSIS, Docker.
2. **MLOps & Production AI Delivery**
   - Reproducible training pipelines, leakage-safe feature preparation, experiment and model tracking, API-based model serving, evaluation, monitoring, and retraining workflows.
   - Stack: MLflow, Feast, FastAPI, PyTorch, GitHub Actions, Docker.
3. **Full-Stack Web & Product Engineering (Web Development & Custom Software)**
   - Purpose-built responsive web applications, FastAPI and .NET backends, C# and WPF desktop operator tools, and database integrations.
   - Stack: React, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core MVC, EF Core, WPF, SQL Server, PostgreSQL.
4. **Custom AI Solutions**
   - Applied AI workflows connecting source material, computer vision, local LLM automation, forecasting, and explicit human review.
   - Stack: PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO, MediaPipe, LangChain, Ollama, FastAPI.

## Industries & Workflows Served
- **Pharmacies & Healthcare Retail:** Searchable catalogs, stock-aware baskets, cash-on-delivery checkout, inventory administration, and separate pharmacist prescription review (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#pharmacies-healthcare-retail`).
- **Retail & E-commerce:** Responsive storefronts, catalog-import pipelines, image reconciliation, and order management (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#retail-ecommerce`).
- **B2B Wholesale & Distribution:** Account-based catalogs, quotation workflows, reorder portals, and spreadsheet/ERP ETL integration (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#wholesale-distribution`).
- **Manufacturing & Industrial Operations:** Desktop and web operator validation tools, template and label checks, and print-proofing workflows (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#manufacturing-industrial`).
- **Logistics & Supply Chain:** Order and dispatch workflow applications, event ingestion pipelines, and exception queues (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#logistics-supply-chain`).
- **Media, Research & Publishing:** Structured source ingestion, AI-assisted draft briefs, and human verification interfaces (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#media-research-publishing`).
- **Environmental Data & Smart Infrastructure:** Continuous telemetry ingestion, reproducible multi-horizon forecasting, and computer vision benchmarking (`https://samintelligencegroup.com/industries#environmental-smart-infrastructure`).

## Verified Case Studies & Flagship Projects
- **Three-City AQI Forecasting Platform (MLOps & Data Engineering):**
  - URL: https://samintelligencegroup.com/case-studies/aqi-forecasting
  - Summary: End-to-end MLOps platform turning hourly AQICN/WAQI and OpenWeather observations into direct 24h, 48h, and 72h air-quality forecasts for Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad.
  - Verified Metrics & Architecture: 105,054 checked-in hourly rows in BigQuery, canonical 606 ordered model features, chronological train/validation/test evaluation across Ridge, Random Forest, and Histogram Gradient Boosting, MLflow registration, strict FastAPI schema validation, Streamlit dashboard, and scheduled GitHub Actions automation.
- **Lobatse Pharmacy (.NET 10 / PostgreSQL / AWS):**
  - URL: https://samintelligencegroup.com/case-studies/lobatse-pharmacy
  - Summary: Custom ASP.NET Core MVC and EF Core pharmacy e-commerce platform for Lobatse, Botswana, connecting a responsive storefront, stock-aware basket, cash-on-delivery checkout, catalog/inventory administration, and a separate authorized pharmacist prescription-review workflow.
  - Verified Metrics & Architecture: 11,204 source catalog rows processed (11,180 created, 19 updated, 5 skipped) with separate imagery reconciliation; hosted on Ubuntu AWS EC2 with PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and Amazon S3 for public media and private prescription documents.
- **DeepGuard (Computer Vision & Multimodal AI):**
  - URL: https://samintelligencegroup.com/projects?project=deepguard
  - Summary: Multi-branch deepfake video detection research system combining visual, motion, physics-informed, forensic, and audio branches with multimodal fusion (186 repository commits, PyTorch, OpenCV, Docker).
- **SAM-EDA (Open-Source Python Package on PyPI):**
  - URL: https://samintelligencegroup.com/projects?project=sam-eda
  - Package URL: https://pypi.org/project/sam_eda/
  - Summary: Published open-source Python utility on PyPI that automates heuristic exploratory data analysis, dataset profiling, and diagnostic reporting.
- **Industrial Print Proofing & Label Validation Suite:**
  - URL: https://samintelligencegroup.com/projects?project=industrial-print-proofing
  - Summary: Custom C#, .NET, and WPF desktop software built for Danial Press workflows to validate templates and labels prior to industrial print production.
